full_prompt_en: A square experimental black-and-white photograph merges a close human face and raised hand with a dark mountainous landscape through translucent overlapping exposures. The image has no single conventional background: a medium-gray haze fills the left upper area, while near-black shadow collects on the right and along the bottom. In the middle left, a sharply sloped mountain ridge rises to a small peak and falls toward the center. Dark clustered vegetation lies below it, with a few narrow upright forms appearing against a pale band. On the right half, the upper face of a dark-haired person materializes from the haze, eyes lowered and long strands falling over the forehead. The nose and closed mouth are partly obscured by a large pale hand crossing diagonally upward from the lower right toward the center. Fingers bend softly near the lips, their contours interrupted by the grain and tonal patterns of the second exposure. The face is not cleanly cut out; it shares gray values and irregular edges with the ridge and foliage, making inner and outer scenes occupy the same visual plane. Thin pale diagonal marks, small white specks, scratches, and soft smears appear across the surface. The hand carries the brightest broad highlight, while the hair and lower landscape form the deepest blacks. Light feels diffused and directionless because the exposures overlap, although the face and hand receive a gentle frontal lift. Areas of fine focus alternate with hazy dissolution and rough analog grain. There is no readable text. The overall composition is intimate and disorienting, holding a quiet downward gesture inside a rugged landscape and a visibly distressed photographic surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形实验性黑白照片通过半透明的重叠曝光，把近处的人脸与举起的手同深色山地景观融合。画面没有单一常规背景：中灰雾气填满左上，近黑阴影聚在右侧和底部。左侧中部，一道陡斜山脊升至小尖峰，再向中央下落。其下有成簇的深色植被，少数细长竖形立在浅色带前。右半边，一名黑发人物的上半张脸从雾中出现，眼睛低垂，长发丝落在额前。鼻子和闭合的嘴被一只大而浅色的手局部遮住，手从右下斜向上穿过中央。手指柔和地弯在唇边，轮廓被另一层曝光的颗粒与明暗图案打断。脸没有被干净地剪出来；它与山脊和枝叶共享灰色明度及不规则边缘，使内在与外在景象占据同一视觉平面。细浅色斜痕、小白点、刮擦和柔软污迹遍布表面。手承担最宽阔的亮色高光，头发与下方景观形成最深的黑色。由于曝光互相重叠，光显得漫射而无明确方向，尽管脸与手受柔和正面亮光提起。局部清晰区域与雾化消融及粗糙模拟颗粒交替。画面没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而令人迷失，把安静的低头动作藏进崎岖景观和明显受损的摄影表面。
style_prompt_en: The experimental monochrome photographic style superimposes distinct visual planes until their outlines partially dissolve into one another. Deep black, smoky middle gray, and milky highlights form a compressed palette, with the brightest broad area crossing darker textured masses. Fine grain, scratches, light leaks, and small white flecks keep the image visibly analog and imperfect. Sharp fragments coexist with hazy passages, so depth becomes ambiguous rather than following one stable focus plane. Diagonal contours cut across softer rounded shapes, while dark clustered texture grounds the lower part of the square. Illumination appears diffused through the combined exposures, making light areas glow without a consistent cast shadow. The overall effect is dreamlike, tactile, and slightly uneasy, with the collision of intimate scale and broad environmental texture defining the visual language.
style_prompt_zh: 这种实验性单色摄影风格叠加不同视觉平面，直到轮廓局部溶入彼此。深黑、烟灰和乳白高光形成压缩的配色，最宽的亮区横过较暗的肌理体量。细颗粒、刮痕、漏光和小白点使图像明显带有模拟媒介的不完美。锐利碎片与雾化段落并存，使纵深含混，而不服从单一稳定焦平面。斜向轮廓切过较柔的圆润形状，深色成簇肌理稳住方画幅下部。光仿佛穿过叠合曝光漫射，使亮处发光，却没有一致的投影。整体效果如梦、可触且略带不安，亲密尺度与宽阔环境肌理的碰撞定义了视觉语言。
theme_en: A downcast face and raised hand merged with a mountainous landscape
theme_zh: 低垂面孔与举起的手同山地景观交叠
name: Daisuke Yokota
